claims.description: list builtins honor their contracts: head/tail of the empty list raise WeftError 'empty list', nth is 0-based and bounds-checked, cons/concat/reverse never mutate their inputs
map, filter and reduce apply weft closures correctly; reduce requires an explicit initial value and folds left
string builtins implement DESIGN.md section 8: clamped str-slice, str-split/str-join round-trip, case ops, str-contains?, and WeftError 'expected string' on non-string primary arguments
render displays values canonically: integral floats without a decimal point, strings as-is, nil, booleans, nested lists parenthesized and space-separated, functions as <fn>

tasks.description: Create src/builtins-lists.mjs with list, head, tail, cons, len, nth, concat, reverse per DESIGN.md section 8 and register them in newGlobalEnv (modify src/env.mjs). Pin non-mutation by asserting the input array is unchanged after cons/concat/reverse. Tests in tests/stdlib-lists.test.mjs exercise everything THROUGH evaluate().

Extend src/builtins-lists.mjs with map, filter, reduce per DESIGN.md section 8. If applying a closure from a builtin needs a helper, export applyFn from src/evaluator.mjs and use it (modify evaluator minimally; do not change existing behavior). Tests in tests/stdlib-hof.test.mjs must use weft closures (fn ...) as the function arguments.

Create src/builtins-strings.mjs and src/builtins-math.mjs per DESIGN.md section 8 and register both in newGlobalEnv (modify src/env.mjs). Tests in tests/stdlib-strings.test.mjs cover slice clamping, split/join round-trips, case ops, contains?, the 'expected string' error, and the math ops including mod sign semantics.

Create src/render.mjs with render(value) per DESIGN.md section 8, then add the str and print builtins to src/builtins-core.mjs (print appends to the global env's __out and returns nil) and ensure registration. Tests in tests/stdlib-render.test.mjs pin every rendering rule including 42 vs 42.5, nested lists, and <fn>.
